name: Monk Mystic Fist
body:
A mystic fist blends arcane magic techniques into their martial arts.

Energetic Fist (Su)

At 2nd level, a mystic fist can empower their strikes as a swift action to deal 1d6 energy damage. Doing so expends one of their daily uses of stunning fist. The energy damage is chosen between acid, cold, electricity, or fire, chosen when the ability is used. If the attack misses, the use of the ability is lost. At 8th level, the attack also deals an extra 1d10 of the energy damage on a critical hit, increased by the multiplier like a burst weapon.

This ability replaces the bonus feat gained at 2nd level.

Spell Casting

At 4th level, a mystic fist gains the ability to cast spells. They use the same spells per day and spells known as a bloodrager, though they may choose any spell available to a sorcerer or wizard when learning spells. They use their Wisdom modifier for their spellcasting ability modifier.

This ability replaces all instances of slow fall, the bonus feats at 6th and 14th levels, and quivering palm.

Mystic Strike (Su)

At 4th level, a mystic fist can deliver melee touch spells as part of a full attack action.

At 8th level, they are also able to deliver ranged touch spell attacks as melee touch attacks during the full attack action.
